scope: Six-method frozen-map comparison with original and independently pilot-calibrated SCS
checks: Exact original author SCS driver warmup and 300-transition trajectory parity at calibrated parameters
Original SCS and DCS numerical settings preserved
Calibrated SCS changes only the author map radius and fixed proposal step
Matched historical VI evaluation and joint-pilot transition budgets recorded separately from elapsed costs
New runs repeat neither fitting nor parameter calibration
Separate 1500-transition warmup and exact first-third production burn-in
Functional ESS uses all post-burn-in scalar states including rejection repeats
Both current backends include all six methods, reports and calibration tables
Historical v1 five-method inputs and report reading remain compatible
limitations: Quick checks establish execution and provenance, not convergence or sampler rankings.
Quick executions overlapped with other validation; their timings are not performance evidence.
Equal fitting evaluations and pilot transitions do not imply equal preparation seconds or identical retained map policies.
Original SCS is an additional author-default baseline and does not apply the joint pilot selections.
Local validation does not substitute for the published revision's platform CI status.
